body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized camera, 57 x 39 x 33 mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring right of centre (a quarter of the width), flash window upper left, shutter and recessed switch on top left over the grip, USB-C and microSD on the right side. Idea PENROSE PROCESS, energy stolen from a spinning black hole: a flat oval halo, the ergosphere, rings the lens. A slim tube comes over the top from the right, enters the halo and splits in a Y: one thin branch spirals into the lens rim and vanishes, the other escapes with more energy, swelling to a fat 14 mm tube that drops down the grip end as a grip column, so the hand closes round a cylinder. It wraps under the bottom and up the back as thumb rest, ending in a top-left corner eyelet; the shutter sits in a ribbed collar on the swelling branch, switch recessed beside it. image[2] = tube camera, grip cylinder, top bridge. image[3] = sketch, top tube and cylinder grip. image[4] = lensed disk, for the halo. image[5] = ribbed ring, red index. Halo ticks, vents, sliding back door. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws
